description: Synthetic: a finished auto-mode turn hands over `! ~/bin/approve-runs`, then Claude Code compacts the idle conversation and prints background-task completions, restored skills and an update notice below it. Those rows are Claude Code's own housekeeping, not the user acting, so the hand-over still stands: the command is the offer (else the card shows the ask with no Send button).
